job.value: Notice the graded card auctions and open a card or the event

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The 'Graded card auctions' section with a countdown and price-tagged card photos reads clearly as an auction rail on the homepage.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The purple auction band is prominent, but the two large promo banners above it take the first look.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'See all >' and card tiles with prices predict opening the event or a card.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Graded card auctions' and 'PSA 10' suit TCG buyers; the countdown is self-explanatory.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Browsing asks nothing the person can't decide.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Cards show price and title only.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: An auction rail on the homepage fits discovery.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Section title, one tagline and price tags carry it.
